clean_story:
Now I will teach you Peace. Peace is like still water in the cave pool, no splash, no wave. It is when no beast growls, no fire crackles loud. It is when tribe sits quiet, no club raised, no voice angry. It is when belly is full, no hunger gnaws. It is when sky is calm, no storm howls. This is Peace.

Discover also Stillness, Quiet, Sky.
